definitions.quantile: linear interpolation on sorted scalar observations
definitions.capped: saved exact FP64 projected_norm == local cap, excludes zero
definitions.strict_cap_pressure: proposal_norm - tau*weight - cap > 1e-10*max(1,cap,proposal_norm); stage0 dual is nonunique so this is not an independent-cap causal test
definitions.stage: post-update expansion stage used by projection
definitions.prices: fixed own batch c0; pooled across distinct batches
definitions.absence: no B16+, live status, model import/forward, tensor replay, scheduler query, remote write

limitations: Counterfactual uncapped or beta0=1 trajectories are unobserved.
Stage0 beta=.75 with pi>=1 already implies every .75 local cap.
Scalar source/price verification does not establish semantic causality.

tiny_block_audit.scope: same 90 SHA-verified sealed files, no additional remote reads
tiny_block_audit.threshold_units: Euclidean norm divided by own local a_lr
tiny_block_audit.role_denominators: 1500 owners x 5 layers per role; canonical/mean one per owner, rewrite/KL saved owner means; do not sum roles
tiny_block_audit.nll_definition: Owner mean across saved rewrite NLL rows; unweighted KL separate
tiny_block_audit.normratio_interpretation: Raw means retained. Thresholded statistics are conditional and do not redefine all-owner realization.
tiny_block_audit.initial_summary_failure: Earlier CPU-only draft treated six-rewrite NLL arrays as scalar; corrected owner_mean_rewrite_nll. No production change.
